issues.title: Swashbuckle.AspNetCore Package Version Outdated
issues.description: The project references Swashbuckle.AspNetCore version 6.4.0, which is outdated. The latest stable version compatible with .NET 8.0 is 6.8.x or 7.x, which includes security fixes, performance improvements, and better OpenAPI 3.1 support.
issues.impact: Updated Swashbuckle.AspNetCore to version 6.8.1 for better .NET 8.0 compatibility, security patches, and performance improvements
issues.remediation: Updated package reference version from 6.4.0 to 6.8.1 in MinimalAPIProject.csproj

issues.title: Inefficient Use of Task.Run for Synchronous Operations
issues.description: The StudentRepository class uses await Task.Run() for operations that are already synchronous. This adds unnecessary overhead and thread pool usage. In .NET 8.0, direct synchronous operations or ValueTask can be more efficient.
issues.impact: Replaced all instances of await Task.Run() with Task.FromResult() to eliminate unnecessary thread pool scheduling and improve performance
issues.remediation: Replaced await Task.Run() calls with Task.FromResult() in all 5 methods: CreateStudent, DeleteStudent, GetAllStudents, GetStudentById, and UpdateStudent. Removed async modifiers where no longer needed.

recommendations: Build completed successfully with 0 errors and 0 warnings
All packages are now compatible with .NET 8.0
Performance improvements implemented by removing unnecessary Task.Run overhead
Consider implementing proper async operations if database or external API calls are added in the future
Run comprehensive integration tests to verify functionality after changes
